title: Pre-flight and connection-time webhook public-IP checks must share one classifier
answers: where should the webhook public IP check be changed
how do I add a new blocked address range to webhook SSRF protection
webhook hostname check and connection check disagree on what is private
which function decides whether a webhook destination is public
body:
Invariant: Every public-address decision on the webhook outbound path goes through mlflow/utils/validation.py:_is_public_ip; both the pre-flight hostname check (_validate_hostname_resolves_to_public_ips) and the connection-time check (mlflow/webhooks/ssrf.py:_assert_public_peer) must call it.
Enforced by: mlflow/webhooks/ssrf.py imports `_is_public_ip` from mlflow/utils/validation.py, so the two layers share one definition.
What breaks if skipped: a bypass closed at one layer stays open at the other; this PR fixed the same IPv6-transition gap in both places at once.
Constraints: Do not add new direct `.is_global` checks on resolved or peer addresses; extend `_embedded_ipv4` or `_is_public_ip` so both layers pick up the change.
applies: Changes to how MLflow classifies destination IP addresses for webhook or outbound URL validation.
says: Webhooks can reach private internal network addresses through inconsistent address validation checks.
Ensure webhook destination verification blocks internal network endpoints during resolution and connection.
Outbound notifications accept restricted network destinations using alternative address transition formats.
Block all internal IP ranges consistently when configuring outbound webhook integrations.
Prevent outbound event webhooks from connecting to private infrastructure after hostname checks pass.
search: All public IP classification for outbound webhooks must centralize in mlflow/utils/validation.py:_is_public_ip across pre-flight resolution and connection-time peer checks. Both _validate_hostname_resolves_to_public_ips and mlflow/webhooks/ssrf.py:_assert_public_peer must use this single helper to prevent SSRF bypasses such as IPv6-transition gaps. Direct .is_global checks must not be added; developers should instead extend _embedded_ipv4 or _is_public_ip.
